user.title: Solis Inverter Local
user.description: Connect to your Solis datalogger's local status page (http://<ip>/inverter.cgi). Both fields come from the label on the datalogger or its web UI.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the datalogger on this IP (check it is powered and on the same network).

init.title: Solis Inverter Local options
init.description: You can change the datalogger's IP address here. Leave the password blank to keep the current one.
